components.name: Primary Dispatch Button
components.description: Primary action button triggering multi-country Amazon comparison.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0.65rem 1.25rem; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: #ffffff; background-color: #bf4520; border: 1.5px solid #141923; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #a33817; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #bf4520; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: ASIN / URL Search Input
components.description: Monospace-enhanced input accepting Amazon URLs, ASINs, or keywords.
components.css: .ds-input-query { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; font-family: 'Azeret Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #141923; background: #ffffff; border: 1.5px solid #334155; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-input-query:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #bf4520; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: NBP FX Rate Chip

components.description: Direct deep link to the regional Amazon product page (/dp/ASIN).

narrative.overview: EuroAmazon Dispatch treats cross-border e-commerce comparison across 9 European and UK Amazon storefronts as a precision logistics and currency arbitrage manifest. Instead of decorative marketing cards or promotional banners, the interface is structured as a high-contrast tabular sheet where live NBP exchange rates, shelf prices, cross-border shipping quotes to Poland, and landed PLN totals lock into an exposed hairline grid.
keyCharacteristics: Exposed structural cell hairlines (1px and 1.5px carbon-navy rules) that separate every currency input, verdict cell, and country row.
Reversed carbon-navy plate (#141923) with clearance mint (#7be0ad) highlights reserved exclusively for the #1 lowest landed PLN offer.
Strict tabular monospace alignment (Azeret Mono with tabular-nums) for all prices, exchange rates, ASIN stamps, and percentage deltas.

rules.name: The Single Reversed Plate Rule
rules.body: Only the #1 lowest landed PLN offer row and the primary winner verdict cell invert to Carbon Navy (#141923) with Clearance Mint (#7be0ad) numerals. Every other row stays on white ledger stock so the winning storefront is scannable in a split second.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every price, shipping fee, exchange rate, and percentage delta is set in Azeret Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums right-aligned in its cell so decimal commas align vertically down all 9 rows.

dos: Do set all prices, exchange rates, and ASIN identifiers in Azeret Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.
Do keep labels above form controls with tighter label-to-input spacing (0.35rem) than group-to-group spacing (1rem).
Do preserve inline editable inputs for both item price and shipping quote in every table row so users can override CAPTCHA-blocked or cart-specific postage rates.
donts: Don't place kickers or eyebrows above section headings; let the heading and ASIN stamp carry hierarchy directly.
Don't use type="number" on postal code or ASIN inputs; use type="text" with appropriate inputmode and autocomplete.
Don't apply the reversed dark carbon plate (#141923) to more than the single #1 winning row in the comparison table.
